categories.main_business_segments: Ocean Plastics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of plastic raw materials, plastic products, and related chemical materials. Its business divisions include Processing, Synthetic Leather, Building Materials, and Raw Materials. The company also engages in real estate development and leasing of residential, industrial, and office buildings, as well as international trade.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes automated production processes including precise mixing systems, extrusion, injection molding, and coating technologies. It develops advanced materials such as flame-retardant composites, high-performance medical-grade plastics, environmentally friendly polymers, and recycled material reuse technologies. The synthetic leather division produces DMF-free water-based PU resins and solvent-free prepolymer PPU resins, emphasizing green and sustainable materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span industries such as construction, medical, sports, electronics, furniture, and industrial applications. Major markets include North America, the Middle East, China, Europe, South Asia, and Japan. The company targets emerging markets in Asia-Pacific and focuses on high-value niche customers in Europe and the Americas.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover Taiwan (with multiple factories and offices), Mainland China (factories in Dongguan and Huizhou), and export markets including North America, Middle East, Europe, South Asia, and Japan. The company actively expands into Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and emerging markets to diversify geographic risk.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ocean Plastics operates primarily in the midstream segment of the plastics supply chain, manufacturing plastic raw materials (PVC powder, pellets) and converting them into finished plastic products such as plastic sheets, synthetic leather, and building materials. It sources raw materials both domestically and internationally and supplies downstream industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high value-added, environmentally friendly, and sustainable products including flame-retardant composites, medical-grade plastics, and green polymers. It invests in digital transformation and smart manufacturing to improve efficiency and reduce costs. Strategic focus also includes expanding green product lines to meet ESG and international environmental standards, and developing new markets through innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of plastic raw materials, synthetic leather, plastic building materials, and related products. The company also earns income from real estate leasing and investments. It maintains stable order sources through long-term customer contracts and diversified market channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces intense competition from global and regional plastic manufacturers, especially from Mainland China with its expanded low-cost capacity. Ocean Plastics differentiates itself by focusing on high-quality, customized, and environmentally friendly products, maintaining a stable reputation in high-end markets. It holds market shares around 5-6% in its main product categories.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$4.68 billion, a 4.7% decrease from the previous year, with a net profit of about NT$167 million. Despite a challenging market environment with rising costs and geopolitical risks, the company maintains stable asset size (~NT$11.8 billion) and equity (~NT$6 billion). It invests around NT$14.7 million annually in R&D and plans to increase R&D spending to NT$11.5 million in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ocean Plastics emphasizes product quality, customization, and environmental sustainability as its core competitive advantages. It offers innovative, high-performance, and green plastic materials that comply with international environmental regulations. The company leverages smart manufacturing and supply chain optimization to ensure timely delivery and cost efficiency, aiming to create long-term value for customers and shareholders.
